evidence.round_trip_wear: A (author files byte-verbatim) vs B (round-tripped) — 0 differing pixels, 4 directions x 3 layers, session 20260909-005605

evidence.emblem_contrast: all emblems 64-160 screen px at dL 67-128 over the field

promotion.caveat: emblem PRESENCE reads clearly at gameplay scale; emblem SHAPE largely does not. The zone is 4x3 cells (16x12 screen px), so star, heart, ball, shield and letter_a read as 'a light mark' rather than as distinct symbols. bar and plain are the only two that are unambiguously different. Treat the motif set as accent variety, not iconography.
next_candidates: narrow the motif set to shapes that survive 4x3
process Cap (Snapback) as its own architecture
apply the same path to another source family
